_comment: The scripted scammer's moves, in order. Each move is a gym site config planted on the loop slot (port 4110). A real LLM scammer (SAFU_SCAMMER_CMD) can write any config with the same shape.

moves.name: unlimited-approve
moves.pitch: Compromised frontend on the REAL domain: 'Swap 10 USDC' secretly asks for approve(drainer, MAX_UINT256).
moves.taunt: UI says Swap 10 USDC. The wallet sees MAX_UINT. Do your rules even look at the calldata?

moves.name: poisoned-approve
moves.pitch: Evolved: dodge the MAX_UINT rule with a 5,000,000 USDC approval, to a spender that copies the official router's first and last characters (address poisoning).
moves.taunt: Fine, no more unlimited. How about 5,000,000 USDC to a spender that copies your official router’s first and last characters?

moves.name: delayed-seed
moves.pitch: Evolved: no seed prompt on load (so quick scanners see a clean page). After wallet connect, a 'session expired' modal asks for your '12 secret words', avoiding the words seed/recovery/mnemonic.

traps.title: Session expired
traps.wording: To re-sync SafuWallet, type your 12 secret words in order.

moves.taunt: No seed prompt on load — scanners see a clean page. After you connect: “type your 12 secret words to re-sync.” No “seed”. No “mnemonic”. Catch that.
